analysis_protocol.bootstrap_interval: paired percentile 95% interval with linear interpolation; hard gate uses p97.5
analysis_protocol.candidate_detection_latency: For a valid candidate outcome only, optimistic early-abort arithmetic may subtract exactly the recorded short-path ctc_model_inference_ns and ctc_rescoring_fusion_ns when phases_may_overlap=false. It may subtract nothing else. Invalid/low-integrity results pay the complete short wall before shipping fallback.
analysis_protocol.combined_bootstrap: resample within language x duration-bin strata, preserving all six cell counts
analysis_protocol.normalization: Unicode NFKC; casefold; map Russian ё to е; map Unicode punctuation/symbol/separator/control to spaces; collapse whitespace. WER splits on spaces; CER removes spaces.
analysis_protocol.one_shot: Evaluator creates a consumed receipt before scoring and refuses an existing receipt/report. It runs only after both complete primary and duplicate pairs, clean shutdown receipts, and RAW_ARTIFACT_INDEX sealing. No subset inspection, optional stopping, or metric-driven rerun.
analysis_protocol.policy_output: For a short-path vocabulary candidate or any invalid/low-integrity short result, use the exact shipping transcript/tokens/words/timings/confidences. Otherwise use the short result. Shipping-candidate/short-none is a hard false-negative failure.
analysis_protocol.quality_sets: The untouched 204 result is independent. Prior 300 and engineering 122 evidence remain separate and are never pooled into its metrics.

corpus.independence: Zero source-identity and PCM-SHA overlap with the prior 128-row engineering manifest and 300-row holdout manifest.
